name: IC Sensor — Knowles
description: Surface-mount audio IC sensor cluster featuring Knowles footprints including SPH0645LM4H-6, LGA-5, and LGA-6 packages.
selection_hints: Select when requiring SMD audio sensor ICs in Knowles package footprints.
Choose based on specific footprints such as SPH0645LM4H-6 (3.5x2.65mm), LGA-5 (3.5x2.65mm), or LGA-6 (4.72x3.76mm).
Consider quality tiers with SPH0645LM4H at Tier A and SPH0641LU4H-1/SPM0687LR5H-1 at Tier B.
avoid_when: Through-hole mounting or non-SMD assembly is required.
The design requires footprints outside the Knowles package family.
A non-audio sensor IC component is required.
